notes: Both branches end at هشام; «قال هشام بن عروة عن أبيه، عن عاصم بن عمر، عن أبيه» is written once after them and belongs to both (rule 3). The gloss «- المعنى -» is left out.
«زاد مسدد» is a wording addition by a man already in the chain: left out. The Companion's father-relation is the last link; the Prophet is not a link.
